name: [FREE SAITAMA] Shadow Battlegrounds
desc:
💥A fast-paced battleground experience with unique abilities, intense PvP, and skill-based combat. Compete to become the strongest and best fighter with characters inspired by your favorite Animes!

🎮Supported devices: (PC, MOBILE, CONSOLE)
👍Be sure to leave feedback on how we can improve!

⭐ Controls
G - Ultimate
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - run
M1 - Punch
